raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 12 re-delivered 345 transactions as duplicates (same txn_id, identical fields, later ingest_ts 05:00). In the re-send, txn_ts is epoch milliseconds, not a timestamp string. I checked that 1768543211000 ms equals 2026-01-16 06:00:11, the same value as the original row, so the duplicate is the same transaction. The fix is to parse epoch-ms timestamps and keep one row per txn_id after the POSTED filter, which removes the cast failure and the double counting in the gold tables.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH parsed AS (SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, ingest_ts, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]+$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'), dedup AS (SELECT * FROM parsed QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts, ts) = 1) SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, ts AS txn_ts, CAST(ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM dedup;"}}
